name: Dumbbell Scaption Raise
cues: Stand tall with dumbbells at your sides, thumbs pointing up
Raise your arms at about 30 degrees in front of your sides

qa.note: Wave 3a 2026-10-08: rated minor, owner review. minor: Scaption itself is right: shoulder plane 30 (upper arm 30 deg forward of the coronal plane), top elevation 90 at shoulder height, grip axis vertical at the top (thumbs up), palms to the thighs at the hang. However, humeral rotation is a constant -60.5 deg, which is about 60 deg of external rotation at the hang (humerus anterior faces lateral, -0.87 x), offset by 61 deg of pronation. Approved 209 hangs at 30 deg internal rotation. The hero view reads acceptably.
